records.name: Alpino Nochhöher
records.biography_en: Regards every summit as a badly placed supply depot. He climbs HyperNorm stairwells with a rope reserved for approved routes. A dissonant card points toward somebody stranded one floor lower. The Men in Black demand a single direction; Hunky and Dory change the destination. He leaves a little room for those who cannot keep up.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Gipfel ist erreicht. Der Nachschub nicht.

variant_notes.note_en: Regards every summit as a badly placed supply depot.

records.name: Bersagliere Eilfertig
records.biography_en: Runs ahead because waiting would make the order seem less certain. His feathered helmet reaches every HyperNorm inspection before his doubts do. A dissonant card asks why he is hurrying. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Eile ist angeordnet. Der Anlass folgt.

variant_notes.note_en: Runs ahead because waiting would make the order seem less certain.

records.name: Tenente Domani
records.biography_en: Sees both sides of a situation and requisitions a third. His binoculars reveal two HyperNorm routes both marked as the only correct one. He keeps the map case closed during briefings. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Aussicht wurde erweitert. Die Entscheidung vertagt.

variant_notes.note_en: Sees both sides of a situation and requisitions a third.

records.name: Meccanica Valvola
records.biography_en: Treats impossible machinery as a personal invitation. Her valve releases the pressure that HyperNorm policy calls essential. A dissonant card suggests trying the same repair on a meeting. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Ventil funktioniert. Der Druck bleibt amtlich.

variant_notes.note_en: Treats impossible machinery as a personal invitation.

records.name: Radiofonista Quasichiaro
records.biography_en: Keeps the channel clear of everything except inconvenient questions. Her receiver carries HyperNorm certainty on one channel and questions on the other. She keeps both tuned despite the interference. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Kanal ist frei von vorzeitigen Gewissheiten.

variant_notes.note_en: Keeps the channel clear of everything except inconvenient questions.

records.name: Sanitario Semprepronto
records.biography_en: Has prepared for every emergency except the scheduled one. His bandage roll is divided into planned and unplanned injuries. HyperNorm residents keep needing the unplanned half first. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Für Unvorhergesehenes vorbereitet, ausgenommen heute.

variant_notes.note_en: Has prepared for every emergency except the scheduled one.
